title: Nice Assortment
text: Nice Assortment. Over the years, I've lost some of our serving pieces. This is a nice assortment and fills the missing pieces. The pieces are a mid-quality. I wouldn't call them the cheap stainless silverware, but they're not the heavy duty ones either. It's nice to have plenty of serving spoons when I need them!
